Frequently Asked Questions
Cybersecurity refers to the practice of protecting computers, networks and data from
unauthorized access, damage or theft. It involves keeping private and sensitive
information — everything from passwords to consumers’ personal information, to private
company financial details and intellectual property — safe from hackers, bots, viruses and
other threats. 
Overall, cybersecurity practices aim to create a secure digital environment by proactively
identifying and addressing vulnerabilities, monitoring for potential threats, and responding
swiftly to mitigate risks.
